result.topic_en: Calculations for the equations of motion of a fluid ellipsoid with internal vortex motion (Riemann's ellipsoid problem), writing the semi-axis equations through elliptic integrals over s and then evaluating such integrals for the case c = a, abc = 1 by means of auxiliary functions f(t), h, g in a variable z.
result.transcription:
$(b-a)^2 v = \tau \quad (b+a)^2 w' = \tau'$
$\frac{\tau^2}{(a-b)^3} + \frac{\tau'^2}{(a+b)^3} - \frac12 \frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial t^2} = \varepsilon A a - \frac{\sigma}{a}$ [-...-] $= \varepsilon A a - \varepsilon C \frac{c^2}{a} - \frac12 \frac{c}{a}\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial t^2}$
$\frac{\tau^2}{(b-a)^3} + \frac{\tau'^2}{(b+a)^3} - \frac12 \frac{\partial^2 b}{\partial t^2} = \varepsilon B b - \frac{\sigma}{b} \quad = \varepsilon B b - \varepsilon C \frac{c^2}{b} - \frac12 \frac{c}{b}\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial t^2}$
$-\frac12 \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial t^2} = \varepsilon C c - \frac{\sigma}{c}$
$\frac12\left(\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}\right)^2\right) + \frac{\tau^2}{(a-b)^2} + \frac{\tau'^2}{(a+b)^2} = 2\varepsilon H + \mathrm{const}$
$\varepsilon A a - \varepsilon C \frac{c^2}{a} = \frac{\varepsilon\pi}{a}\int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(a^2-c^2)s}{(a^2+s)(c^2+s)}$
$\varepsilon B b - \varepsilon C \frac{c^2}{b} = \frac{\varepsilon\pi}{b}\int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(b^2-c^2)s}{(b^2+s)(c^2+s)}$
$\frac{2\tau^2}{(b-a)^3} = \frac{\varepsilon\pi}{b}\int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(b^2-c^2)s}{(b^2+s)(c^2+s)} - \frac{\varepsilon\pi}{a}\int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(a^2-c^2)s}{(a^2+s)(c^2+s)} = \varepsilon\pi p \quad a=b=c=\mathrm{const}$
$\frac{2\tau'^2}{(b+a)^3} = \quad + \quad = \varepsilon\pi q$
$\frac{2\tau^2}{\varepsilon\pi(b-a)^3} = p + \frac12\frac{\partial^2 (b-a)}{\varepsilon\pi\partial t^2} + \frac12\frac{(b-a)c}{ab}\frac{\partial^2 c}{\varepsilon\pi\partial t^2}$
$\frac{2\tau'^2}{\varepsilon\pi(b+a)^3} = q + \frac12\frac{\partial^2 (b+a)}{\varepsilon\pi\partial t^2} + \frac12\frac{b+a}{ab}c\frac{\partial^2 c}{\varepsilon\pi\partial t^2}$
$c=a \quad abc=1 \quad b=\frac{1}{a^2}$
$\frac{\delta c}{c}+\frac{\delta b}{b}+\frac{\delta a}{a}=0 \quad -\delta c = \delta a + a^3\delta b = \frac12(\delta a+\delta b)(a^3+1)+(\delta b-\delta a)(a^3-1)$
$[-...-]\,3p\frac{\delta b-\delta a}{b-a} + \delta a\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial a} - \frac{c}{a}\frac{\partial p}{\partial c}\right) + \delta b\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial b} - \frac{c}{b}\frac{\partial p}{\partial c}\right) - \mu\mu(\delta b-\delta a) + \frac{b-a}{ab}c^2\mu\mu\left(\frac{\delta b}{b}+\frac{\delta a}{a}\right)$
$3q\frac{\delta b+\delta a}{b+a} + \quad - \mu\mu(\delta b+\delta a) + \frac{b+a}{ab}c^2\mu\mu\left(\frac{\delta b}{b}+\frac{\delta a}{a}\right)$
$f(t) = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{tt+s}\,(1+s)} = \int_0^\infty \frac{t\,\partial s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(1+tts)} \quad t=\cos y \quad \frac{\partial t}{\partial y}=u \quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=t \quad tt-uu=1 \quad f(t)=\frac{2y}{u} \quad \frac{\partial \log t}{\partial y}=\frac{u}{t}$ \quad $\int_{\frac{1}{t}}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{1}{t}}}$ [?] $\quad \sqrt{s}\; s-1$ [?]
$\partial\left(\frac{1}{t}f t\right) = \int\frac{-2tt\,\partial s\,s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(1+tts)^2} = \partial\frac{2y}{tu} = \frac{2}{tu} + 2y\left(-\frac{u}{ttu} - \frac{t}{uut}\right)\frac{t}{u}$ \quad $\frac{\partial\log t}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial \log u}{\partial y} = \frac{1}{z}$ [?] \quad $\log\frac{1+\sqrt{t-t}}{1-\sqrt{t-1}}$ [?] \quad $\sqrt{s+1}-\sqrt{s}$ [?]
$h = \int\frac{s\,\partial s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(\frac{1}{tt}+s)^2} = -\frac{tt}{uu} + y\left(\frac{t}{u}[-...-] + \frac{t^3}{u^3}\right) = \int\frac{t^4\,\partial s}{\sqrt{tt+s}\,(1+s)^2}$
$\frac{\partial \log z}{\partial y} = \frac1z - z$
$[-\frac{\partial h}{\partial t} = \int\frac{4s\,\partial s\,t^{-2}}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(\frac{1}{tt}+s)^3} = \left(3\frac{t}{u^4}+\frac{1}{ut}+y\left(-\frac{1}{tt}-\frac{1}{uu}-3\frac{tt}{u^4}+\frac{1}{uu}\right)\right)\frac{t}{u}-]$ \quad $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 1-zz$
$\frac{\partial\log t}{\partial y} = \frac{1}{z}$
$\partial\frac{1}{t}h = \int\frac{-tt\,s\,\partial s}{(tt+s)^{\frac32}(1+s)^2}$ [-$= (3\frac{1}{u^3}+2\frac{1}{utt}+y(-\frac{1}{uut}-2\frac{1}{t^3}-3\frac{t}{u^4}))\frac{t}{u}$-]
$= \left(+3\frac{tt}{u^3} + y\left(+\frac{t}{uu} - 3\frac{t^3}{u^4}\right)\right)\frac{t}{u}$ \quad $\frac{g}{t}$ [?] $= z^2 + y z^{1-zz}$ [?]
$z^2 + y(z - z^3 - 2z^5)$ [?]
$h = -z^2 + y(z+z^3) \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 1-zz \quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial\log t} = z$ \quad $g' = -h'z^2 - 4g(z^2-1)$
$t f(t) = 2yz$ \quad $(s+1)-(s+\frac{1}{tt}) = 1-\frac{1}{tt}$
$[-h-]\, -tt\,\partial\frac{2yz}{tt} = -tt\,\partial\frac{yz}{tt} = (z+y(1-zz))z + 2yz = -z^2+y(z+z^3)$ \quad $(1-\frac{1}{tt})g' = -h' - 4g\frac{1}{tt} \quad (1-a^6)g' = -h' - 4ga^6$
$g' = -zz(h'+4g)$ [?]
$h' = -2z^2(1-zz) + z^2(1+zz) + y(z+3z^3)(1-zz)$ \quad $-z^4+15z^6+yz^3+6z^5-15z^7$ [?]
$= -z^2+3z^4+y(z+2z^3-3z^5) = \int\frac{4s\,t^{-2}\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+s)}\,(\frac{1}{tt}+s)^3} = \int\frac{a^{-4}\,s\,\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+a^4 s)}\,(1+\frac{s}{aa})^3}$ \quad $(s+tt)-s+1 = tt-1$
$(tt-1)g = -t$ [?] \quad $12z^4-12z^6+y$
$\partial\frac{1}{t}h = \int\frac{-tt\,s\,\partial s}{(tt+s)^{\frac32}(1+s)^2} = \frac{h'}{t}-\frac{h}{t} = \frac{1}{t}\left(3z^4+y(z^3-3z^5)\right) = \int\frac{-t^3\,s\,\partial s}{(1+s)^{\frac32}(1+tts)^2} = \frac{g}{t}$ \quad $h'-h = g$
$\partial t\,\partial\frac{1}{t}h = \left(12z^3(1-zz) + (z^3-3z^5) + y(3z^2-15z^4)(1-zz)\right)z$
$= 13z^4 - 15z^6 + y(3z^3-18z^5+15z^7) = g'$ \quad $g'-3g = 4z^4-15z^6+y(-9z^5+15z^7)$
$\partial t^3 g = 3\int\frac{tt\,s\,\partial s}{(tt+s)^{\frac32}(1+s)^2} = t^{-3}(g'-3g)$ [-...-] \quad $\frac{1}{t}$ [?] $\; g'-3g = 3\int\frac{a^{-4}\,s\,\partial s}{(1+a^4 s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^2}$
$\partial[-g-] = [-4-]\int\frac{-4t^{-2}\,s\,\partial s}{(1+s)^{\frac32}(\frac{1}{tt}+s)^3} = [-...-]\,g'$ [-...-] \quad [-$g'+g$-] $= -4\int\frac{a}{}$
$g' = -4\int\frac{a^{-4}\,s\,\partial s}{(1+a^4 s)^{\frac32}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^3}$

methods.what: Equations of motion for the semi-axes of a fluid ellipsoid with vortex-motion constants τ, τ'

methods.quote: $\frac12\left(\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial t}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial t}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial t}\right)^2\right) + \frac{\tau^2}{(a-b)^2} + \frac{\tau'^2}{(a+b)^2} = 2\varepsilon H + \mathrm{const}$

methods.what: Gravitational coefficients expressed as elliptic integrals over s
Definition of p (and q) for relative-equilibrium conditions
Variation (perturbation) of the equations about c=a with volume constraint abc=1
Closed-form evaluation of integral f(t) via substitution t = cos y (hyperbolic)
Expression of integral h in terms of z and y
methods.quote: $h = -z^2 + y(z+z^3) \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 1-zz \quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial\log t} = z$

methods.what: Derivative h' and its integral representation
Integral representations of g'-3g and g'
